kultivator.screen.help.bintang.title: Bintang Abadi: stars beyond True Immortal
kultivator.screen.help.bintang: A disciple at True Immortal Peak with a full bar stores every further XP as Qi Bintang. Star n costs min(5 billion, 500,000 x 1.07^(n-1)); with "Otomatis" on (default) a star condenses by itself, and the count has no cap. Each star adds max health, attack, technique damage, max qi and meditation XP (twice under the open night sky); every 9 stars finish a Stellar stage (Nebula, Meteor, Star Core, Planet, Tribulation, Stellar, Dark Star, Black Hole, then Infinite I, II...). Seven Calamities in three Trials gate stars 6, 15, 24, 33, 42, 51, 60 (7 or 8 for better foundations): start them from the Jalan tab, stay close and guard. After all seven the disciple is Penginjak Langit and lights a Soul Lamp every 10 stars; putting one out is another calamity. From star 28 Divine Clones fight beside it. Source: Renegade Immortal (Ancient Gods grow by stars and face Three Trials with Seven Calamities), Stellar Transformations (the stages, Qin Yu absorbing star power), I Shall Seal the Heavens (Soul Lamps), Coiling Dragon (Divine Clones).
kultivator.screen.help.ikatan.title: Bond, Soul Seal, Hu Fa and the heir
kultivator.screen.help.ikatan: Bond (0-100) grows when you teach (+5), feed pills (+2, 10 a day), guard a breakthrough (+10), meditate near the disciple (+1 a minute, 20 a day) and when it wins bouts or rescues you. At 50, sneak-use a Soul Seal Jade on it: recall it from anywhere in the dimension, +10%% health and damage, and it rushes to you when you drop below 30%% health. Guard (Hu Fa) by meditating or standing still while sneaking within 8 blocks during its breakthrough or calamity: softer strikes, better quality, Tahan Petir to take a strike yourself. At bond 80, rank Inti and Nascent Soul a sealed disciple can be named heir: your techniques, half your comprehension, hexes, and the Master's Soul Ring. A disciple whose power passes yours surpasses you. Source: Tales of Demons and Gods (Soul Seal), Battle Through the Heavens (Yao Lao guarding Xiao Yan; the soul in the ring), I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 102, 1379, 1534-1556 (the Nine Hexes, one Demon Sealer per generation), Renegade Immortal (Tu Si's legacy), Martial Universe (the Desolate Hall's direct disciple); surpassing the master: Battle Through the Heavens (Xiao Yan outgrows Yao Lao), Martial Peak (Yang Kai surpasses Meng Wu Ya).

kultivator.dpath.art.xuantian.safe: A line of sword light from 3 blocks ahead: 8 U to monsters within 2 blocks of it.
kultivator.dpath.art.xuantian.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: a trench along the aim, 3 wide and 4 deep, length min(48, 16 + stars/2).
kultivator.dpath.art.xuantian.source: Source: A Record of a Mortal's Journey, ch. 2191/2238: the Xuantian Slaying Spirit Sword, a Xuantian treasure of the highest tier, draining Han Li's mana.

kultivator.dpath.art.lotus.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens: the Buddha's Fury Flame Lotus grows far more destructive with each flame fused into it. Needs 2 Heavenly Flames.
kultivator.dpath.art.quake.safe: A pulse through the ground: 6 U, monsters launched and slowed (Slowness IV, 4 s).
kultivator.dpath.art.quake.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: a disc 3 deep below the surface, radius min(R + 4, 6 + stars/6), natural stone, dirt, sand and gravel only.
kultivator.dpath.art.quake.source: Source: Coiling Dragon: Linley's earth mystery of the Pulse, vibration that shatters rock from within.
kultivator.dpath.art.desolation.safe: Life drains from the monsters around it (2 U) and gathers into the disciple: it heals fully, you and nearby disciples heal 30%%, +30%% damage for 30 s.
kultivator.dpath.art.desolation.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: the surface withers in radius min(R + 8, 8 + stars/6): grass to coarse dirt, plants gone, crops and farmland spared, no holes.
kultivator.dpath.art.desolation.source: Source: Martial Universe: the Great Desolation Scripture desolates a thousand miles around the user and gathers life force into one body.
kultivator.dpath.art.prison_hand.safe: A giant hand presses a 9 x 9 column: 8 U and the monsters inside are held for 5 s.
kultivator.dpath.art.prison_hand.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: a 9 x 9 pit, depth min(12, 3 + stars/18).
kultivator.dpath.art.prison_hand.source: Source: Martial Universe, ch. 701: the Great Desolate Imprisoning Heavenly Hand.
kultivator.dpath.art.sumeru.safe: Nine build-up blows (the hammer glyph grows), then 15 U in radius + 4.
kultivator.dpath.art.sumeru.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: after the nine blows, a sphere of radius min(R, 4 + stars/9).
kultivator.dpath.art.sumeru.source: Source: Soul Land: the Clear Sky Sect's Disorderly Cloak Hammer Technique builds force over chained blows, and the Great Sumeru Hammer is its devastating ultimate.
kultivator.dpath.art.hell_monarch.safe: A 24-block crimson nova of 6 U around the disciple, under a crimson sky (particles).
kultivator.dpath.art.hell_monarch.destro: Mode Kehancuran: a sphere of radius min(R, 4 + stars/5).
kultivator.dpath.art.hell_monarch.source: Source: Against the Gods, ch. 46: the seventh Heretic God gate; Hell Monarch is the last realm the blood memory names. Needs gate 7.
kultivator.dpath.art.devouring.safe: A vortex of radius 8 pulls monsters in for 4 s, 1 U a second.
kultivator.dpath.art.devouring.destroy: Mode Kehancuran: a column of radius 3 from the target's surface down 16 blocks.
kultivator.dpath.art.devouring.source: Source: Martial Universe: the Devouring Ancestral Symbol devours energy. Only for the bearer of the Devouring symbol.
kultivator.dpath.art.mountain_sea.safe: Nine seal pulses of 3 U in a 3 x 3 grid, radius 4 each.
kultivator.dpath.art.mountain_sea.destro: Mode Kehancuran: nine spheres of radius min(4, R) in a 3 x 3 grid, 8 blocks apart.
kultivator.dpath.art.mountain_sea.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens, ch. 1556: the Lord of the Mountain and Sea Realm must master all Nine Hexes. Only for an heir with all nine.

kultivator.dpath.ui.auto.name: Otomatis

kultivator.dpath.ui.calamity.tip: Pays the star's cost; a 6 s omen, then 6 + k strikes of lightning (particles only, never a block). Guard it: stay within 8 blocks and meditate.
kultivator.dpath.ui.lamp.tip: A calamity with k = 8 + lamps already out. Each lamp out: +10%% range and +5%% damage.
kultivator.dpath.ui.tahan.name: Tahan Petir
kultivator.dpath.ui.tahan.tip: You take the next strike yourself: half its share of your max health (never below 1 health). 15%% of your max qi, at most 3 per trial.
kultivator.dpath.ui.tahan.none: No breakthrough or calamity with strikes is running.
kultivator.dpath.ui.tahan.pending: Ready: the next strike is yours.
kultivator.dpath.ui.recall.name: Soul Seal Recall
kultivator.dpath.ui.recall.tip: Calls the sealed disciple to a safe spot beside you (same dimension, cooldown 60 s).
kultivator.dpath.ui.heir.tip: A 60-second ritual: you meditate within 4 blocks, 30%% of your max qi. The heir learns your techniques for free and gets hexes.
kultivator.dpath.ui.heir.replace: Your heir now is %s: it keeps its techniques but loses every hex.
kultivator.dpath.ui.picker.tip: Click the left or right half to choose the technique for the hex buttons below.
kultivator.dpath.ui.picker.hexed: Carries a hex of the heir (+25%%).
kultivator.dpath.ui.gen_hex.tip: Marks one of your techniques the heir knows as the Generation Hex: its version deals +50%% with a seal ring.
kultivator.dpath.ui.hex.name: Create Hex
kultivator.dpath.ui.hex.tip: Every new realm and every 9 stars the heir creates a hex on a technique without one: +25%%. At most nine.
kultivator.dpath.ui.descend.tip: For 20 s the heir fights with your power, a Buddha Palm and Dao Domain pulses of your Dao (monsters only). You pay 40%% of max qi and 2 qi a second, slowed. Cooldown 10 minutes.
kultivator.dpath.ui.honor.name: Tetua Kehormatan
kultivator.dpath.ui.honor.tip: While you meditate within 8 blocks of this disciple you gain 5%% of its meditation XP.
kultivator.dpath.ui.honor.locked: Only for a disciple that surpassed you.
kultivator.dpath.ui.duel.tip: A duel with you: both at 80%% health or more within 16 blocks, 120 s, ending at 10%% health. Once a day; both gain comprehension and bond. Win and it surpasses you.
kultivator.dpath.ui.heir.source: Source: I Shall Seal the Heavens ch. 102, 1379, 1534-1556 (the League of Demon Sealers passes down one Demon Sealer per generation, each creating a new hex; a Mountain and Sea Lord must master all Nine Hexes); Renegade Immortal (Wang Lin inherits Tu Si's legacy and memories); Martial Universe (Lin Dong becomes a senior direct disciple of the Desolate Hall).
kultivator.dpath.ui.surpass.source: Source: Battle Through the Heavens (Xiao Yan outgrows Yao Lao and later rescues him from the Hall of Souls); Martial Peak (Meng Wu Ya, keeper of the Contribution Hall, knew and healed the trial disciple Yang Kai, who later surpassed him).
kultivator.dpath.ui.cast.tip: The block-safe form: big effects and damage to monsters only. Cooldown 10 minutes.
kultivator.dpath.ui.cast_destroy.tip: All three locks are open: sneak while looking at the target within 10 s, check the preview, confirm in chat, then a warning to the whole dimension. Real blocks will change.

kultivator.dpath.ui.release.tip: Lock 3: releases this disciple's red seal (opens the blood-red warning). Its ordered Jurus Pemusnah may then change blocks.
kultivator.dpath.ui.seal_close.tip: One click: the red seal closes and any destruction of yours stops at once.
kultivator.dpath.ui.not_peak: Bintang Abadi begins at True Immortal Peak with a full bar: from then on every XP becomes Qi Bintang.
kultivator.dpath.ui.first_gate: Its first calamity will come at star %s.
kultivator.dpath.ui.stars_source: Source: Renegade Immortal (Ancient Gods grow by stars), Stellar Transformations (the stages), Battle Through the Heavens (grades in stars).
kultivator.dpath.ui.calamities.name: Seven Calamities, Three Trials
kultivator.dpath.ui.calamities.tip: 2 + 2 + 3 calamities. Each finished Trial multiplies every star bonus by 1.1. A failed calamity wounds (never kills) and returns half the cost.
kultivator.dpath.ui.calamities.source: Source: Renegade Immortal, ch. ~1157-1159: Ancient Gods face Three Trials with Seven Calamities; most meet the first at six stars, very few at eight (Tu Si).
kultivator.dpath.ui.trampling: Penginjak Langit: all Seven Calamities passed.
kultivator.dpath.ui.bonus_meditation: Meditation XP x%s (x2 under the open night sky)
kultivator.dpath.ui.bonus_meditation_nig: Meditation XP x%s now: the open night sky
kultivator.dpath.ui.bonus_reduction: Health beyond the cap: %s%% damage reduction

kultivator.dpath.ui.bond.tip: Teach +5, pills +2 (10 a day), guard a breakthrough +10, meditate within 8 blocks +1 a minute (20 a day), bouts won +3, rescues +5. 50: Soul Seal, 80: heir.
kultivator.dpath.ui.bond.source: Source: Tales of Demons and Gods: the Soul Seal of loyalty; ch. 343 "Taking in a disciple".
kultivator.dpath.ui.seal_hint: Sneak-use a Soul Seal Jade on the disciple (amethyst shard, echo shard, gold ingot, paper).
kultivator.dpath.ui.recall_none: No other sealed disciple to recall in this dimension.
